project_name: Mini Cloud App Candidate Release v1.2

must_measure.target: Process memory RSS leak during continuous operation
must_measure.methodology: 30-minute steady-state burn-in under 200 req/s open arrival
must_measure.threshold: RSS growth <= 5% across 20,000 requests after initial warm-up
must_measure.blast_radius_if_omitted: Host OOM killer terminates application worker after days of production uptime

must_measure.target: Latency distribution under open arrival schedule
must_measure.threshold: p95 latency <= 50ms, p99 latency <= 100ms at target 200 req/s load
must_measure.blast_radius_if_omitted: Queue backlog cascade during minor service pause causing client timeouts

must_test.target: Token expiration and signature verification fail-closed invariant
must_test.methodology: Automated security test suite injecting expired and corrupted HMAC tokens
must_test.threshold: 100% of expired or invalid tokens receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized
must_test.blast_radius_if_omitted: Security boundary breach permitting unauthorized session reuse

must_test.target: Atomic transaction rollback on multi-table document creation
must_test.methodology: Simulated disk error injected during secondary table insert
must_test.threshold: SQLite recovery leaves database in consistent pre-transaction state without orphan records
must_test.blast_radius_if_omitted: Relational data corruption requiring manual database repair

must_inspect.target: Repository git tree and configuration secret leakage
must_inspect.methodology: Static scan of commit history and environment config files
must_inspect.threshold: Zero private keys, session tokens, or DB passwords found in repository code
must_inspect.blast_radius_if_omitted: Credential compromise via accidental source exposure

must_inspect.methodology: Manual and simulated schema inspection via preship_validator.py
must_inspect.threshold: All newly added columns are NULLABLE or have defined DEFAULT values
must_inspect.blast_radius_if_omitted: Emergency rollback crashes previous application version with column missing errors

acceptable_unknown.description: System availability during an unexpected multi-hour regional power loss on the host hardware
acceptable_unknown.justification: This project is explicitly bounded to a single-node architecture with localized storage; multi-region active-active failover is out of scope for current budget and design constraints.
acceptable_unknown.blast_radius_if_omitted: Total downtime for the duration of the physical power outage (acknowledged and accepted)

acceptable_unknown.description: B-Tree indexing overhead when document table exceeds 10,000,000 rows on low RAM hosts
acceptable_unknown.justification: Target scale for current candidate release is bounded to 100,000 documents; 10M row scaling is cataloged in the M25 learning plan.
acceptable_unknown.blast_radius_if_omitted: Increased query latency if database unexpectedly exceeds 100x target scale

deployment_compatibility.app_code_compatibility: Backward-compatible with existing client mobile and web apps (no breaking REST schema changes)
deployment_compatibility.recovery_justification: Candidate migration adds a nullable 'summary' column to the documents table. The previous application version ignores this column and continues reading and writing baseline fields without error. Code rollback is safe.
deployment_compatibility.stated_data_loss_bound: Committed transactions: Zero loss. In-flight HTTP requests during restart window (< 3.0 seconds): Bounded to socket timeout; clients receive clean connection reset and may retry.
